items.title: Scott Yanow interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 22, 2021
items.q: Is Rosemary Clooney a jazz singer? Well she sings jazz tunes and she swings. But does she improvise much? You know one could debate about that.

ctx.x: Okay. Well speaking of words, I wanted to ask you about I’ve recently been reading your Jazz Singers book and by the way, now I own two copies because Jeannie Cheatham sent me your book. So she must have liked what you wrote about her. And a couple of things I wanted to mention, I was very happy to turn to page 233 under Nancy Wilson and see my favorite LP of all time, the one she did with Cannonball. The other thing I enjoyed was your talk about what makes a jazz singer. And if you don’t mind I wonder if you…

It’s always a tricky thing because with jazz there’s a lot of instances where it’s borderline. Is Rosemary Clooney a jazz singer? Well she sings jazz tunes and she swings. But does she improvise much? You know one could debate about that. And of course one always debates about Frank Sinatra and Tony Bennett. Are they really jazz singers? Well sort of and sort of not. You know. Where someone like Kurt Elling or Betty Carter or Mel Torme, they’re definitely jazz singers. So I mean the quality that is needed is that…

Yeah there’s been a number of singers over the years who have come out with the debut album and I don’t know if it’s their choice or the record companies and they’ll get Ron Carter and people of that talent level to play behind them. And when you listen to it you say well it’s a jazz trio but it’s not really a jazz singer.
